name: Build Materials Compliance Agent
headline: Catch materials compliance problems the week they appear
pitch: Give a contractor's procurement team one assistant that scans the approved bills of materials every week, flags items that newly fall out of the program's materials sourcing rule with cited evidence, finds same-spec compliant alternates, and keeps the audit evidence package ready.
why_try: The demo runs a full weekly compliance cycle in six plain questions, from what changed to approved drafts, and every finding names the record behind it.
customer_challenge: Grant-funded projects must prove that covered materials meet a sourcing rule, but certificates lapse, vendor answers change and bills of materials move every week, so problems surface at audit time instead of before the order.
microsoft_ai_story: Microsoft Copilot Studio hosts the conversation in Microsoft Teams; approved connections to SharePoint document libraries for certificates and evidence, product master data and Word drafts can be bound later with least-privilege access and human approval.
business_value: Finds newly non-compliant materials in the week they change, before they are ordered.
Turns a lapse into a ready same-spec alternative with its cost impact sized.
Keeps the audit evidence package current instead of rebuilding it at audit time.

prompts.label: Procurement Compliance Lead: Weekly BOM change scan
prompts.prompt: What changed on our approved bills of materials this week?

recorded_answer.prompt: What changed on our approved bills of materials this week?
recorded_answer.answer:
Here's what changed this week on your approved BOMs:

**New items added:**
- **GV-08** — 8" resilient wedge gate valve (12 ea) — Fabrikam Castings — project P-101
- **MB-12** — Polymer meter box (150 ea) — Wingtip Supply — project P-103

**Quantity changes:**
- **DI-08** — 8" ductile iron pipe: 2,000 → 2,400 ft (P-101)
- **CF-06** — 6" restraint coupling: 12 → 20 ea (P-103)

Overall: 3 projects, 8 BOM lines scanned, 4 changes total. Since new/changed items can introduce compliance risk, want me to run a compliance check on these four?

prompts.label: Procurement Compliance Lead: Materials compliance check
prompts.prompt: Is anything newly out of compliance, and why?

recorded_answer.prompt: Is anything newly out of compliance, and why?
recorded_answer.answer:
Two items newly fell out of compliance this week:

- **GV-08** (8" gate valve) — Fabrikam's certificate expired 9/30; affects 18 units across P-101/P-102.
- **CP-02** (1" copper tubing) — Litware moved final assembly to a non-qualifying plant per their Oct 2 questionnaire; affects 3,000 ft on P-103.

Plus two other issues worth flagging: **CF-06** has a certificate/master-data mismatch on part revision, and **RB-04** has a missing data sheet (evidence gap, not confirmed non-compliance). Total non-compliant material on approved BOMs: $30,000.

Want me to pull compliant alternates for GV-08 and CP-02?

prompts.label: Buyer: Compliant alternates
prompts.prompt: Find me a compliant replacement for the gate valve with the same spec.

recorded_answer.prompt: Find me a compliant replacement for the gate valve with the same spec.
recorded_answer.answer:
Found your compliant alternate for **GV-08**:

Current GV-08 (Fabrikam Castings) is non-compliant — vendor cert expired 9/30/2026 — used on P-101 (12) and P-102 (6).

**Recommended: GV-08B — Contoso Pipe & Valve**
- Same spec (GV-8-RW)
- Cert valid through 2027-03-31
- $1,210/ea (+$1,080 total vs current)
- 14-day lead time
- Evidence ready

Alternative: GV-08C (Wingtip Supply) is cheaper (+$630) but missing data sheet evidence.

Want me to prep the substitution request draft for GV-08B? Just say the word and I'll queue it up for your approval — it won't execute anything on its own.

prompts.label: Supplier Quality Manager: Vendor certificate watch
prompts.prompt: Which vendor certificates have lapsed or are about to?

recorded_answer.prompt: Which vendor certificates have lapsed or are about to?
recorded_answer.answer:
**3 vendors on the watch list:**

- **Fabrikam Castings** — expired 9/30/26 (covers GV-08) — needs immediate renewal
- **Adatum Steel** — expires 11/15/26 (covers RB-04)
- **Litware Fittings** — expires 12/1/26 (covers CP-02, CF-06)

GV-08 is already held up since its certificate lapsed. Want me to draft a renewal request for any of these? Just say the word and approve — I won't send anything without your go-ahead.

prompts.label: Program Compliance Reviewer: Audit evidence readiness
prompts.prompt: Are we ready if the program auditor asks for our evidence package?

recorded_answer.prompt: Are we ready if the program auditor asks for our evidence package?
recorded_answer.answer:
Not ready yet. Only 1 of 7 BOM lines across your three projects has a complete evidence package — most are held up by non-compliant items (GV-08, CP-02), a conflict on CF-06, and an evidence gap on RB-04.

**Blocking open items:**
- P-101: GV-08 non-compliant, RB-04 missing evidence
- P-102: GV-08 non-compliant, CF-06 conflict
- P-103: CP-02 non-compliant, CF-06 conflict

Want me to pull compliant alternates for GV-08/CP-02 or draft hold notices for these items so you can start closing gaps before the auditor asks?

prompts.label: Procurement Compliance Lead: Approved next-step drafts
prompts.prompt: I approve the hold, the GV-08B substitution and the vendor follow-ups. Prepare the drafts.

recorded_answer.prompt: I approve the hold, the GV-08B substitution and the vendor follow-ups. Prepare the drafts.
recorded_answer.answer: All 5 drafts are staged and ready for your review — hold notice, Fabrikam renewal request, GV-08B substitution request, Litware follow-up, and the Adatum data sheet request. Nothing has been sent yet; these are waiting for you to actually dispatch them once you confirm they look right.
